test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

National development is defined as an improvement in people's __daily arrangements__, the provision of fundamental necessities to citizens such as food, education, social services, medical help, and so on, as well as an increase in per capita income.
solution:
The correct answer is: **living conditions**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Living conditions**" is the most appropriate option as it accurately conveys the meaning of "an improvement in people's daily arrangements".
 
• "Living conditions" includes the provision of fundamental necessities and an increase in per capita income. This refers to the circumstances in which people live, including their housing, environment, and overall quality of life, which is directly related to daily arrangements and improvements.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**diving techniques**" This refers to methods used in diving and is unrelated to daily life arrangements.
 
• **"dining categories" - **This refers to types of dining or food-related classifications, which does not encompass the broader aspects of daily life.
 
• **"existing calamities" **- This refers to current disasters or misfortunes, which again does not relate to daily life improvements.
